name: Balyo SA
summary: Balyo SA designs, develops, and markets material handling robots worldwide. The company's products include robotic initial lift stackers and pallet trucks, counterbalanced stackers, tractors, tuggers, and reach and counterbalanced trucks. Its products are used in storage, supply and removal, loading and unloading, logistics train, stock line scanning, and barcode scanning applications. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Ivry-sur-Seine, France.
